paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.27% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.53%) and Hang Seng weakest (-1.55%). Brent crude changed +0.02% to 95.84. Gold changed +0.03% to 3,886.3. Bitcoin changed -1.59% to 67,161.7422. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.154%, a relative move of +1.00%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (-2.40%) and Invesco (+2.35%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Sam Bankman-Fried would have made nearly $40bn in Anthropic IPO (FT Markets). Jailed cryptocurrency mogul loses out on windfall from early investment in the AI lab Deals and capital markets: Amazon revives deal with troubled data centre venture backed by Rick Perry (FT Companies). Tech giant agrees to be Fermi’s anchor tenant after failed talks and boardroom turmoil sent data centre group’s shares south Central banks and macro: German coalition disagreements hold up ECB jobs deal (FT World). Chancellor and his finance minister have yet to agree on a candidate for one of three central bank executive board vacancies Central banks and macro: US Treasuries record worst week since Trump’s ‘liberation day’ (FT Markets). Higher than expected inflation and hawkish remarks by Fed officials have stung investors who bet a global bond rout was over Geopolitics and trade: Global oil markets swing to surplus as Gulf shipments rebound (FT Markets). IEA analysts warn it will take months to rebuild stockpiles depleted by US-Iran war
